message.text: I found the four webhook dispatchers (created, updated, deleted, comment.created) all route through webhook.PostAsync in the internal webhook package, so I want to check that function's definition and confirm there aren't any other dispatch points like reaction webhooks I might be missing.

args.command: cd /bench/repo && grep -n "func PostAsync" -A 20 internal/webhook/webhook.go; echo "=== all dispatchers ==="; grep -rn "func (s \*APIV1Service) Dispatch.*Webhook" server/router/api/v1/*.go
cd /bench/repo && grep -n "asyncPostQueue\|func init\|go func\|workerCount\|for payload" internal/webhook/webhook.go | head -20
